    Bug 2028456 - Reset .gecko_rev.yml GECKO_HEAD_REF to default.
    
    The account hub widget landing accidentally pinned GECKO_HEAD_REF to
    892b1a338388, an m-c revision from before the last rust vendor.
    
    Restoring the default.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310029

diff --git a/.gecko_rev.yml b/.gecko_rev.yml
index bdd27198c2a..454d09ff591 100644
--- a/.gecko_rev.yml
+++ b/.gecko_rev.yml
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 ---
 GECKO_BASE_REPOSITORY: https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-unified
 GECKO_HEAD_REPOSITORY: https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-central
-GECKO_HEAD_REF: 892b1a338388282b83cf4a2b2aa3153acad70263
+GECKO_HEAD_REF: default
 ######
 
 ### For comm-central
title: Bug 2028456 - Reset .gecko_rev.yml GECKO_HEAD_REF to default.
